top_signals.title: Europe Has Already Drained 10% of Its Summer Gas Injections
top_signals.summary: Europe has not only entered the heating season with the lowest gas levels in storage sites in decades, but it has also withdrawn in recent weeks 10% of the natural gas injected during the summer filling season, leaving supply vulnerable to potentially extreme cold winter weather. So far into the heating season, which has just started, the net withdrawals of European countries have reached about 10% of the 51.2 billion cubic meters of gas they had injected into storage sites this summer, Azeri outlet APA-Economics reports, quoting data from Gas…

top_signals.summary: Antonio Simoes always knew he had big shoes to fill at Legal & General.
